# BK3633 SDK provenance

Vendored from [Beken BK3633 BLE SDK](https://gitee.com/beken-corp/bk3633_ble_sdk)
commit `0a461f8ed4a4f17ff6889d6f9d34e521b92b8243`, retrieved 2026-08-14.

The imported `SDK/` tree contains 1,091 build-relevant files totaling
13,718,399 bytes. Included file types are C and assembly source, headers,
linker/build configuration, Keil project files, and text linker/symbol files.
Generated binaries, libraries, maps, disassembly listings, IDE user options,
PDFs, spreadsheets, and Windows utilities are excluded.

The deterministic tar hash of the initially imported `SDK/` tree, using sorted
paths, zero timestamps, and numeric owner/group zero, is:

`2df03cb56bab839de7a51b8aefdc5fc0f481e405ddc12be18ee33f4bdfffe3c6`

The upstream Apache-2.0 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) is retained; its SHA-256 is
`1eb85fc97224598dad1852b5d6483bbcf0aa8608790dcc657a5a2a761ae9c8c6`.

No imported SDK source file was modified during the initial vendoring. Future
changes to inherited files must carry a prominent modification notice as
required by Apache-2.0. BK3635-specific files should use a distinct name or
directory where practical.
